judging.title: Judges
judging.subtitle: The people who score the entries of this challenge.
judging.adminOnly: Only the admin can add, change or remove judges.
judging.howItWorks: Anyone with an account can be a judge — no role is needed. Entries are shared among the judges automatically. A judge you add while scoring is under way gets every entry that is waiting in their stages.
judging.emptyHelp: Add people who have an account, or invite others by email.
judging.addHelp: Pick one person or many. They are told straight away and find their entries under My judging.
judging.addIdeaHelp: Pick one person or many to score this idea.
judging.ideaHelp: The people who score this idea. Only the admin can change them.
judging.ideaEmpty: No judges yet for this idea.
judging.peopleHelp: Type a name or email. You can add several people.
judging.emailsHelp: For people who don't have an account yet. Separate addresses with a comma. Each person gets a link to sign up and becomes a judge when they do.
judging.stageNotInChallenge: This challenge does not have this stage.
judging.chooseSomeone: Choose a person or type an email address.
judging.invitedHelp: They become a judge when they sign up with the link. You can also copy the link and send it yourself.
judging.emailNotSent: Email not sent — copy the link and send it yourself

reason.SAME_TEAM: is on the team of this idea
reason.MANAGER: their manager is on the team
reason.DIRECT_REPORT: a team member reports to them

judging.changeStagesHelp: Entries they have not scored yet in a stage you switch off are taken away. Scores already submitted stay.
judging.removeHelp: Entries they have not scored yet are given to the other judges. Scores they already submitted stay.
judging.removedKept: Judge removed. Their submitted scores were kept.
judging.sharedNothing: Nothing new to share. Every waiting entry already has its judges.
judging.invitesHelp: These people become judges when they sign up with their link.
judging.builderNote: Judges are not chosen here. After you save, the admin adds them on the challenge's Judges tab — at any time, also after publishing.
judging.goToJudges: Judges are chosen on the Judges tab.
judging.adminSubtitle: Choose who judges each challenge and each idea.
judging.challengeFieldHelp: Pick a challenge to see and change its judges.
judging.chooseChallengeFirst: Choose a challenge from the list above.
judging.ideaFieldHelp: Ideas that are waiting for judging or being judged.
judging.chooseIdeaFirst: Choose an idea from the list above.
judging.noIdeasToJudge: No ideas are waiting for judging.
judging.personManyHelp: Pick a person, then pick the next one. You can add as many judges as you need.
judging.averageHelp: {{scored}} of {{total}} judges have scored. The average is used for shortlisting.
judging.entryHelp: Choose one or many judges for this submission, with a due date. Each judge scores it and sees it under My judging. The average of their scores is its score.
judging.entryEmpty: No judges chosen for this entry yet.
judging.addEntryHelp: Pick people from the list. They score this entry only.
